_comment: Single source of truth for constants shared by the Python core, the Node driver and the Luau runtime. The harness builders (core/harness.py, src/harness.js) inject the chunk-hash values into runtime/envlog.luau's `local PROTO = {...}` line at build time, and test/protocol_test.py fails CI when any copy drifts. Do not hardcode these values anywhere else.
